frame: datum frame of intake/alignment.json: origin = mounting hole H1 axis ∩ PCB top face; +Z out of the component side; +X along the long board edge (clock: +X short-edge normal); theta CCW about +Z from +X. Component placements are axis-aligned (0/90 deg) unless a direction is given as a vector.

board_x_min.estimator: robust line fit (Cauchy 0.05) on the x_min edge-wall faces, value at mid-span; 552 faces, slope -0.030 deg

board_x_max.estimator: robust line fit (Cauchy 0.05) on the x_max edge-wall faces, value at mid-span; 345 faces, slope 0.011 deg

board_y_min.estimator: robust line fit (Cauchy 0.05) on the y_min edge-wall faces, value at mid-span; 1773 faces, slope -0.041 deg

board_y_max.estimator: robust line fit (Cauchy 0.05) on the y_max edge-wall faces, value at mid-span; 1874 faces, slope 0.083 deg

board_thickness.estimator: minus the median lowest z of the edge-wall faces per 3 mm station (top face = z 0 by datum); the solder side is not scanned
board_thickness.note: consistent with a standard 1.6 mm FR-4 board; kept as measured (no snap: scan source)
board_thickness.rerun_trigger: F03 caliper reading of the board thickness -> re-run

slot_y.estimator: no-data pixels of the routed slot, per-column extent median over x -4..1 (height map, 0.1 mm)

slot_x_end.estimator: max x of the slot no-data region (round end, radius = half width)

hole_H1.estimator: IRLS circle (Cauchy 0.1) on 414 inner bore-wall faces, z -1.45..-0.15, angular coverage 360 deg; [cx, cy, r]

hole_H2.estimator: IRLS circle (Cauchy 0.1) on 406 inner bore-wall faces, z -1.45..-0.15, angular coverage 340 deg; [cx, cy, r]

hole_H3.estimator: IRLS circle (Cauchy 0.1) on 181 inner bore-wall faces, z -1.45..-0.15, angular coverage 260 deg; [cx, cy, r]

hole_H4.estimator: IRLS circle (Cauchy 0.1) on 200 inner bore-wall faces, z -1.45..-0.15, angular coverage 310 deg; [cx, cy, r]

hole_H5.estimator: IRLS circle (Cauchy 0.1) on 267 inner bore-wall faces, z -1.45..-0.15, angular coverage 280 deg; [cx, cy, r]

hole_H6.estimator: IRLS circle (Cauchy 0.1) on 247 inner bore-wall faces, z -1.45..-0.15, angular coverage 270 deg; [cx, cy, r]

hs_top_z.estimator: median height-map z of the extrusion top face (z > 24.3)

hs_bottom_z.note: heatsink root is hidden (fins seen down to ~0.3 mm above the board); modelled standing on the board top

hs_hub_upper.estimator: hub: [cx, cy, R_hub, hole_r, channel_x0, channel_x1]; centre and hole r = Kasa on the screw-channel no-data boundary; R_hub = radius where the top-mask ring fill drops below 0.8 (0.1 mm rings); the C-shaped channel opens outward (away from the spine) between the short fins: x0/x1 = empty top-mask run across the channel axis at r 1.6..3.2 from the hub centre (median)

hs_hub_lower.estimator: hub: [cx, cy, R_hub, hole_r, channel_x0, channel_x1]; centre and hole r = Kasa on the screw-channel no-data boundary; R_hub = radius where the top-mask ring fill drops below 0.8 (0.1 mm rings); the C-shaped channel opens outward (away from the spine) between the short fins: x0/x1 = empty top-mask run across the channel axis at r 1.6..3.2 from the hub centre (median)

hs_spine_notch.estimator: [y0, y1, z_top] of the notch under the TO-220: +X-facing faces at x 46.8..48.2 below z 13 (package back seen through the spine notch)
hs_spine_notch.note: the notch is taken through the full spine thickness, down to the board

hs_spine_x.estimator: median per-row x extent of the spine top between the hubs (height map)

hs_fin_01.estimator: fin/crossbar arm (lower hub): PCA line of the arm pixels outside the hub; root extended 1.2 mm into the hub, tip = far end minus half width; width = median per-station width; [root_x, root_y, tip_x, tip_y, width]

hs_fin_02.estimator: fin/crossbar arm (lower hub): PCA line of the arm pixels outside the hub; root extended 1.2 mm into the hub, tip = far end minus half width; width = median per-station width; [root_x, root_y, tip_x, tip_y, width]

hs_fin_03.estimator: fin/crossbar arm (lower hub): PCA line of the arm pixels outside the hub; root extended 1.2 mm into the hub, tip = far end minus half width; width = median per-station width; [root_x, root_y, tip_x, tip_y, width]

hs_fin_04.estimator: fin/crossbar arm (lower hub): PCA line of the arm pixels outside the hub; root extended 1.2 mm into the hub, tip = far end minus half width; width = median per-station width; [root_x, root_y, tip_x, tip_y, width]

hs_fin_05.estimator: fin/crossbar arm (lower hub): PCA line of the arm pixels outside the hub; root extended 1.2 mm into the hub, tip = far end minus half width; width = median per-station width; [root_x, root_y, tip_x, tip_y, width]

hs_fin_06.estimator: fin/crossbar arm (lower hub): PCA line of the arm pixels outside the hub; root extended 1.2 mm into the hub, tip = far end minus half width; width = median per-station width; [root_x, root_y, tip_x, tip_y, width]

hs_fin_07.estimator: fin/crossbar arm (upper hub): PCA line of the arm pixels outside the hub; root extended 1.2 mm into the hub, tip = far end minus half width; width = median per-station width; [root_x, root_y, tip_x, tip_y, width]

hs_fin_08.estimator: fin/crossbar arm (upper hub): PCA line of the arm pixels outside the hub; root extended 1.2 mm into the hub, tip = far end minus half width; width = median per-station width; [root_x, root_y, tip_x, tip_y, width]

hs_fin_09.estimator: fin/crossbar arm (upper hub): PCA line of the arm pixels outside the hub; root extended 1.2 mm into the hub, tip = far end minus half width; width = median per-station width; [root_x, root_y, tip_x, tip_y, width]

hs_fin_10.estimator: fin/crossbar arm (upper hub): PCA line of the arm pixels outside the hub; root extended 1.2 mm into the hub, tip = far end minus half width; width = median per-station width; [root_x, root_y, tip_x, tip_y, width]

hs_fin_11.estimator: fin/crossbar arm (upper hub): PCA line of the arm pixels outside the hub; root extended 1.2 mm into the hub, tip = far end minus half width; width = median per-station width; [root_x, root_y, tip_x, tip_y, width]

hs_fin_12.estimator: fin/crossbar arm (upper hub): PCA line of the arm pixels outside the hub; root extended 1.2 mm into the hub, tip = far end minus half width; width = median per-station width; [root_x, root_y, tip_x, tip_y, width]

hs_shortfin_01.estimator: short fin (lower hub): PCA in a +/-14 deg wedge about the hub; [root_x, root_y, tip_x, tip_y]
hs_shortfin_01.note: width from hs_fin_width_short (stub too short for a per-station width)

hs_shortfin_02.estimator: short fin (lower hub): PCA in a +/-14 deg wedge about the hub; [root_x, root_y, tip_x, tip_y]
hs_shortfin_02.note: width from hs_fin_width_short (stub too short for a per-station width)

hs_shortfin_03.estimator: short fin (upper hub): PCA in a +/-14 deg wedge about the hub; [root_x, root_y, tip_x, tip_y]
hs_shortfin_03.note: width from hs_fin_width_short (stub too short for a per-station width)

hs_shortfin_04.estimator: short fin (upper hub): PCA in a +/-14 deg wedge about the hub; [root_x, root_y, tip_x, tip_y]
hs_shortfin_04.note: width from hs_fin_width_short (stub too short for a per-station width)

hs_fin_width_short.estimator: mean of the measured long-fin widths, applied to the 4 short fins

q1_body.estimator: [x_front, x_back, y0, y1, z_bottom, z_top]: front = median x of -X faces; back = tab front face; y from the top-view (1/99 pct); bottom = 1st pct z of the front faces; top = median height map

q1_tab.estimator: [x_front, x_back, y0, y1, z_top]: front = -X faces above the body, back = +X faces seen through the spine notch; tab spans z from the body bottom to z_top

q1_tab_hole.estimator: [y, z, d]: IRLS circle (Cauchy 0.1) in (y, z) on the bore-wall faces inside the tab (x 46.1..47.45)

hs_spine_hole.estimator: [y, z, d]: IRLS circle (Cauchy 0.1) in (y, z) on the bore-wall faces inside the spine (x 47.6..49.0); only the lower arc (z < 18.6) is scanned (the TO-220 screw hole in the heatsink; not coaxial with the tab hole)

q1_lead_1.estimator: [y, then x, z pairs from the board up]: median x of the lead faces per 0.5 mm z bin (z 0.25..4.25), Douglas-Peucker 0.15 mm; the lead continues straight up to the body bottom
q1_lead_1.note: lead cross-section from q1_lead_w / q1_lead_t (standard TO-220)

q1_lead_2.estimator: [y, then x, z pairs from the board up]: median x of the lead faces per 0.5 mm z bin (z 0.25..4.25), Douglas-Peucker 0.15 mm; the lead continues straight up to the body bottom
q1_lead_2.note: lead cross-section from q1_lead_w / q1_lead_t (standard TO-220)

q1_lead_3.estimator: [y, then x, z pairs from the board up]: median x of the lead faces per 0.5 mm z bin (z 0.25..4.25), Douglas-Peucker 0.15 mm; the lead continues straight up to the body bottom
q1_lead_3.note: lead cross-section from q1_lead_w / q1_lead_t (standard TO-220)

q1_lead_w.estimator: TO-220 lead width / thickness (JEDEC TO-220AB nominal), not resolvable on the scan

q1_lead_t.estimator: TO-220 lead width / thickness (JEDEC TO-220AB nominal), not resolvable on the scan

clip_path.estimator: top-view strap pixels (12.3 < z < 14.3), skeletonised, ordered end-to-end, Douglas-Peucker 0.25 mm; flattened [x1, y1, x2, y2, ...]

clip_hook.estimator: section z 10 of the scan in x 48.0..51.2, y -38.9..-36.3 (strap outer surface around the fin tip), DP 0.25; strap centre offset not applied (outer surface used as the path)

clip_width.estimator: median 2x distance-transform at the skeleton (top view)

clip_z.estimator: [z_bottom = 2nd pct of strap side faces, z_top = median strap top]

cap_C1.estimator: [axis x, y at z 0, dx/dz, dy/dz, r_base, groove z0, r_groove, groove z1, r_body, z_top]: IRLS circles (Cauchy 0.1) on the outward can-wall faces per 1 mm z bin; axis = weighted line through the bin centres (rms < 0.08, coverage >= 225 deg); r_body = median of the upper-half bins; the sealing groove = lower bins > 0.12 below r_body (z to 0.5 mm, the bin size); r_base = bins under the groove; z_top = median height map inside 0.75 r
cap_C1.note: groove z limits are 1 mm bin edges (+/-0.5 mm)

cap_C2.estimator: [axis x, y at z 0, dx/dz, dy/dz, r_base, groove z0, r_groove, groove z1, r_body, z_top]: IRLS circles (Cauchy 0.1) on the outward can-wall faces per 1 mm z bin; axis = weighted line through the bin centres (rms < 0.08, coverage >= 225 deg); r_body = median of the upper-half bins; the sealing groove = lower bins > 0.12 below r_body (z to 0.5 mm, the bin size); r_base = bins under the groove; z_top = median height map inside 0.75 r
cap_C2.note: groove z limits are 1 mm bin edges (+/-0.5 mm)

cap_C3.estimator: [axis x, y at z 0, dx/dz, dy/dz, r_base, groove z0, r_groove, groove z1, r_body, z_top]: IRLS circles (Cauchy 0.1) on the outward can-wall faces per 1 mm z bin; axis = weighted line through the bin centres (rms < 0.08, coverage >= 225 deg); r_body = median of the upper-half bins; the sealing groove = lower bins > 0.12 below r_body (z to 0.5 mm, the bin size); r_base = bins under the groove; z_top = median height map inside 0.75 r
cap_C3.note: groove z limits are 1 mm bin edges (+/-0.5 mm)

cap_C4.estimator: [axis x, y at z 0, dx/dz, dy/dz, r_base, groove z0, r_groove, groove z1, r_body, z_top]: IRLS circles (Cauchy 0.1) on the outward can-wall faces per 1 mm z bin; axis = weighted line through the bin centres (rms < 0.08, coverage >= 225 deg); r_body = median of the upper-half bins; the sealing groove = lower bins > 0.12 below r_body (z to 0.5 mm, the bin size); r_base = bins under the groove; z_top = median height map inside 0.75 r
cap_C4.note: groove z limits are 1 mm bin edges (+/-0.5 mm)

cap_C5.estimator: [axis x, y at z 0, dx/dz, dy/dz, r_base, groove z0, r_groove, groove z1, r_body, z_top]: IRLS circles (Cauchy 0.1) on the outward can-wall faces per 1 mm z bin; axis = weighted line through the bin centres (rms < 0.08, coverage >= 225 deg); r_body = median of the upper-half bins; the sealing groove = lower bins > 0.12 below r_body (z to 0.5 mm, the bin size); r_base = bins under the groove; z_top = median height map inside 0.75 r
cap_C5.note: groove z limits are 1 mm bin edges (+/-0.5 mm)

capstem_C5.estimator: [stem r, stand-off z]: stem r = 1st pct radius of board-level faces seen under the can - 0.1; stand-off = lowest 0.2 mm z bin whose outward can-wall faces cover >= 180 deg; applied only when the board is seen deep under the can (stem r < 0.7 x base r), otherwise it is the curled bottom edge

cap_C1_base.estimator: [x0, x1, y0, y1, z_top] of C1's SMD V-chip base plate: SMD V-chip base: pixels 0.6..2.2 above the board outside the can (+0.25), side walls z 0.35..1.2

x2_CX1.estimator: [x0, x1, y0, y1, z_top]: height-map pixels above half height (bbox), top = median of the >85% pixels
x2_CX1.rerun_trigger: F08 caliper L x W x H -> re-run

faston_x.estimator: per tab: mid-plane of the median +X and -X blade faces (z 3..9)

faston_y.estimator: per tab: mid of the median +Y and -Y blade-edge faces (z 3..9)

faston_width.estimator: blade width = +Y face - -Y face median per tab

faston_thickness.estimator: blade thickness = +X face - -X face median per tab

faston_top_z.estimator: 95th pct height map over the blade per tab
faston_top_z.rerun_trigger: a caliper reading of this dimension -> re-run measure and rebuild

faston_chamfer.estimator: 45-deg corner chamfer leg = (blade width - top-view width 0.3 mm below the top)/2 + 0.3, per tab; tab 5 excluded (its top-view extent is merged with a neighbour, extent > width)

faston_foot_len.estimator: foot (base) length = +Y minus -Y foot-face medians (z 0.3..1.5); tabs with a missing foot face excluded

faston_foot_top_z.estimator: highest z where the tab section is wider than the blade + 0.5

faston_foot_dx.estimator: x offset of the foot mid-plane from the blade mid-plane

faston_hole_z.estimator: detent hole centre z (Kasa on the -X face occupancy hole)

faston_hole_d.estimator: detent hole diameter (Kasa on the -X face occupancy hole)

faston_hole_dy.estimator: detent hole y offset from the blade centre

conn_J1.estimator: [x0, x1, y0, y1, z_top, cav_x0, cav_x1, cav_y0, cav_y1, cav_floor_z]: housing walls = dominant side-wall faces; cavity = inner-wall faces (else 2/98 pct of the low pixels); floor = median z of the up-facing faces inside the cavity when >= 20 exist, else the lowest scan point seen (no-data fraction 0.94: the true floor may be deeper)

conn_J2.estimator: [x0, x1, y0, y1, z_top, cav_x0, cav_x1, cav_y0, cav_y1, cav_floor_z]: housing walls = dominant side-wall faces; cavity = inner-wall faces (else 2/98 pct of the low pixels); floor = median z of the up-facing faces inside the cavity when >= 20 exist, else the lowest scan point seen (no-data fraction 0.96: the true floor may be deeper)

conn_J3.estimator: [x0, x1, y0, y1, z_top, cav_x0, cav_x1, cav_y0, cav_y1, cav_floor_z]: housing walls = dominant side-wall faces; cavity = inner-wall faces (else 2/98 pct of the low pixels); floor = median z of the up-facing faces inside the cavity when >= 20 exist, else the lowest scan point seen (no-data fraction 0.50: the true floor may be deeper)

connpin_J1_01.estimator: [x0, x1, y0, y1, z_top]: contact / rib standing > 0.8 mm above the lowest point seen inside the cavity (height-map component bbox, top = 90th pct)

connpin_J1_02.estimator: [x0, x1, y0, y1, z_top]: contact / rib standing > 0.8 mm above the lowest point seen inside the cavity (height-map component bbox, top = 90th pct)

blk_K1.estimator: [base x0, x1, y0, y1, z_top, riser x0, riser back x at the base top, riser back x at its top, riser y0, y1, z_top]: base walls = dominant side-wall faces; riser front / y = pixels above 60% of the base-to-riser rise; riser back = line fit x(z) on its +X-facing faces (rms 0.165)

box_bump_K2_1.estimator: [x0, x1, y0, y1, z_top]: part standing > 0.5 mm on the block's base top, away from the riser (height-map component bbox, 90th pct top)

box_bump_K2_2.estimator: [x0, x1, y0, y1, z_top]: part standing > 0.5 mm on the block's base top, away from the riser (height-map component bbox, 90th pct top)

blk_K2.estimator: [base x0, x1, y0, y1, z_top, riser x0, riser back x at the base top, riser back x at its top, riser y0, y1, z_top]: base walls = dominant side-wall faces; riser front / y = pixels above 60% of the base-to-riser rise; riser back = line fit x(z) on its +X-facing faces (rms 0.321)

ax_R1.estimator: [x_axis, z_axis, r, y0, y1, then per lead: x, y_far_end, z_top]: IRLS circle in (x, z) on the body faces; y ends and leads from the height map (lead strips > 0.5 mm above the board)

axlead_R1_1.estimator: descending part of the lead (x, y, z triples), from the board up: median x and y of the lead faces per 0.4 mm z bin up to 1.0 below the lead top, Douglas-Peucker 0.15 (3D)

axlead_R1_2.estimator: descending part of the lead (x, y, z triples), from the board up: median x and y of the lead faces per 0.4 mm z bin up to 1.0 below the lead top, Douglas-Peucker 0.15 (3D)

box_side_R1_1.estimator: [x0, x1, y0, y1, z_top]: low part beside the body, merged with it in the top view (pixels 0.25..1.5 above the board, > r + 0.3 from the axis; bbox above half its height)

box_side_R1_2.estimator: [x0, x1, y0, y1, z_top]: low part beside the body, merged with it in the top view (pixels 0.25..1.5 above the board, > r + 0.3 from the axis; bbox above half its height)

box_side_R1_3.estimator: [x0, x1, y0, y1, z_top]: low part beside the body, merged with it in the top view (pixels 0.25..1.5 above the board, > r + 0.3 from the axis; bbox above half its height)

ax_D1.estimator: [x_axis, z_axis, r, y0, y1, then per lead: x, y_far_end, z_top]: IRLS circle in (x, z) on the body faces; y ends and leads from the height map (lead strips > 0.5 mm above the board)

axlead_D1_1.estimator: descending part of the lead (x, y, z triples), from the board up: median x and y of the lead faces per 0.4 mm z bin up to 1.0 below the lead top, Douglas-Peucker 0.15 (3D)

axlead_D1_2.estimator: descending part of the lead (x, y, z triples), from the board up: median x and y of the lead faces per 0.4 mm z bin up to 1.0 below the lead top, Douglas-Peucker 0.15 (3D)

ax_D2.estimator: [x_axis, z_axis, r, y0, y1, then per lead: x, y_far_end, z_top]: IRLS circle in (x, z) on the body faces; y ends and leads from the height map (lead strips > 0.5 mm above the board)

axlead_D2_1.estimator: descending part of the lead (x, y, z triples), from the board up: median x and y of the lead faces per 0.4 mm z bin up to 1.0 below the lead top, Douglas-Peucker 0.15 (3D)

axlead_D2_2.estimator: descending part of the lead (x, y, z triples), from the board up: median x and y of the lead faces per 0.4 mm z bin up to 1.0 below the lead top, Douglas-Peucker 0.15 (3D)

box_side_D2_1.estimator: [x0, x1, y0, y1, z_top]: low part beside the body, merged with it in the top view (pixels 0.25..1.5 above the board, > r + 0.3 from the axis; bbox above half its height)

box_side_D2_2.estimator: [x0, x1, y0, y1, z_top]: low part beside the body, merged with it in the top view (pixels 0.25..1.5 above the board, > r + 0.3 from the axis; bbox above half its height)

ax_L2.estimator: [x_axis, z_axis, r, y0, y1, then per lead: x, y_far_end, z_top]: IRLS circle in (x, z) on the body faces; y ends and leads from the height map (lead strips > 0.5 mm above the board)

axlead_L2_1.estimator: descending part of the lead (x, y, z triples), from the board up: median x and y of the lead faces per 0.4 mm z bin up to 1.0 below the lead top, Douglas-Peucker 0.15 (3D)

lead_d.estimator: through-hole lead wire diameter (typical 0.6-0.8 for these parts); the scan-dilated strip widths 0.7-1.2 mm cannot resolve it

ycap_CY1.estimator: [cx, cy, cz, nx, ny, nz, core_R, rim_rho]: soft-L1 SDF fit of a rounded disc (flat core swept by a sphere) to the visible faces z > 6.5 (necks and faston blades excluded); sdf rms 0.112

ycap_lead_1.estimator: 3D PCA line on the lead faces; [x,y,z low end, x,y,z high end]

ycap_lead_2.estimator: 3D PCA line on the lead faces; [x,y,z low end, x,y,z high end]

box_001.estimator: SMD/low part (segment 62): axis-aligned bbox of the pixels above half its height (0.1 mm raster), top = median z of the >80% pixels; min-rect angle 4.1 deg (placed at 0/90)

box_002.estimator: SMD/low part (segment 66): axis-aligned bbox of the pixels above half its height (0.1 mm raster), top = median z of the >80% pixels; min-rect angle 0.0 deg (placed at 0/90)

box_003.estimator: SMD/low part (segment 17): axis-aligned bbox of the pixels above half its height (0.1 mm raster), top = median z of the >80% pixels; min-rect angle 0.0 deg (placed at 0/90)

box_004.estimator: SMD/low part (segment 22): axis-aligned bbox of the pixels above half its height (0.1 mm raster), top = median z of the >80% pixels; min-rect angle 0.0 deg (placed at 0/90)
